Sun Data Analytics, LLC produces one-off and tailored reports for specific client questions, research needs, or decision points.

## Overview

Custom reports are useful when you do not need a full recurring reporting system, but you do need a clear answer, a defensible method, or a polished explanation of existing evidence. Reports can be concise or detailed depending on the question and audience.

## Report Formats

:::: {.index-list}
::: {.index-item}
### Data Briefs

Short reports with key findings, charts, tables, assumptions, and plain-language interpretation.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Technical Notes

Method-focused documents that explain source data, cleaning choices, calculations, limitations, or validation steps.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Executive Summaries

Decision-oriented summaries that highlight the main findings, implications, and recommended next questions.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Research Memos

Written synthesis for research, evaluation, exploratory analysis, public-safe summaries, or client-facing findings documents.
:::
::::
